# Create Projectile Effect

Source: [wiki article 4546](../archive/4546.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Create Projectile Effect](../../api/actions/create-projectile-effect.md).

<a id="wiki-4546-n1"></a>

- Projectile effects are persistent visual entities using Last Created Entity, with entity-capacity failure; the page describes no damage/healing behavior.

<a id="wiki-4546-n2"></a>

- Friendly To selects whose perspective sees friendliness; oversize spans 0–1 with type-specific maximum and selected visual inputs reevaluate.
